description: Rename, move or resize an artboard, or switch it between portrait and landscape (Object > Artboards > Switch Orientation). Position is measured from artboard 0's top-left corner. scaleArtwork scales and moves the artwork on it with it

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

orientation.description: Swap width and height to make it portrait or landscape, or switch whichever it is. The top-left corner stays put

scaleArtwork.description: Scale and move the artwork whose centre lies on the artboard along with it. Default false

name: set_artboard
title: Set Artboard
